Minibus to Bagratashen
Minibus
✎Georgia
Bus 1851 to the Georgian border leaves the bus station at 7:55 and 14:30; a Georgian minibus then runs at 10:30 from the border to Samgori metro. Coming back, leave Samgori bus station at 7:30 (or 8) for the border, then minibuses at 10:00 and 16:45 on to Vanadzor. Seats run out, so call ahead. Shalva on the numbers above; Gocha on +37494769717 / +995593244954.
₳1000 AMD + 7 GEL

Minibuses Vanadzor – Gyumri
Minibus
✎Gyumri
From Vanadzor bus station at 9:30 and 11:30; from Gyumri at 14:00 and 16:00. Buy the ticket at the bus-station desk in the morning, or reserve a seat with the driver. The 9:30 and 14:00 runs are the new Ford (minibus 374, Aren, +37498420696 ); the 11:30 and 16:00 runs are the older Gazelle (minibus 430, +37493420696 ).
₳800 AMD

Vanadzor

The city on stage

Vanadzor is the third-largest city in Armenia and the capital of Lori Province, about 128 km north of Yerevan. It sits at roughly 1,350 m in the valley where the Tandzut and Vanadzor rivers run into the Pambak River, hemmed in on either side by the Bazum and Pambak mountain ranges, both of which rise above 2,500 m. That valley floor is why the city is long and narrow rather than round, and why its districts are strung out along the water. Those two walls are the ridgelines drawn as outlines behind the title at the top of this page.

It was known for centuries as Gharakilisa, was renamed Kirovakan in 1935 after the Soviet official Sergey Kirov, and took the name Vanadzor on 25 June 1992, after independence. Under the Soviet Union it was a chemical-industry town — the acetate silk plant was the largest single employer — and much of that industry did not survive the transition. The infamous 1988 Spitak earthquake struck the city hard — roughly half its building stock was damaged or destroyed — though it shook less violently than Spitak and Gyumri, which sat closer to the epicentre and lost far more.

The plate below draws the municipal boundary, the river confluence and the city's named districts. Every listing in this index is somewhere inside that outline.
